$comment: Single source of truth for the MCP servers used by this demo. scripts/setup.ps1 renders client-specific configs from this file. Endpoints verified against Microsoft Learn, October 2026.

servers.role: Create and manage workspaces, items, folders, roles, and item definitions (including Ontology TMDL).
Fabric API specs, item schemas and best practices (offline), OneLake file and table tools, Data Factory pipelines and Dataflow Gen2.
Author semantic models in natural language: tables, measures, relationships, RLS, calculation groups, translations, best-practice fixes, DAX queries.
servers.status: Remote (preview). Tenant setting 'Users can use the Power BI Model Context Protocol server endpoint' must be on.

servers.role: Same authoring tools plus Power BI Desktop, PBIP/TMDL files on disk, transactions and traces.
servers.status: Local (GA). Requires XMLA endpoint Read Write for Fabric workspaces. Accept the EULA on first use.

servers.role: Read-only: discover reports and semantic models, inspect schema, search values, run DAX as the signed-in user (RLS/OLS enforced).
Ground an agent in one ontology: entities, relationships, rules and bound data.
servers.status: Remote (preview). One endpoint per ontology item. Requires paid F2+ (or P1+) capacity.
